note: The ai10 cast (SPEC section 5): one entry per seat, matched by seat name. Pass it with --seat-models data/seat-models-ai10.json, or copy it and change it.
Five seats on a strong model (cook, dealer, robber, muscle, informant) and five on a cheap one. Four model families: OpenAI, Anthropic, Moonshot, Google.

Cast by temperament (D55): in hotkey mini, claude-sonnet-5-5 was the model that played safe. Its results/README.md says 'Sonnet mostly ignored reckless', and in ai-s2 the Sonnet seat set to risk 0.95 made 6 risky moves where gpt-6.1-sol at 0.90 made 13. So the two robbers and the cook are not on Sonnet: they are on gpt-6.1-sol and claude-haiku-5-5, the two models whose settings showed in mini.

NOT CHECKED: google/gemini-3.8-flash was in mini's default list but never played a mini season, so how boldly it plays is unknown. It sits in two chain seats (a smuggler, the gunrunner), away from the robbers and the cook.
NOT CHECKED: the OpenRouter ids were copied from mini and were listed on OpenRouter on 2026-11-07. Nothing here was called. A dry run checks them before any season.
The personas are first drafts written by the builder so a fake season has ten voices. They are slime's to rewrite: the persona is the only personality an agent is given.

seats.persona: Grew up on the water and trusts boats more than people. Counts everything twice. Polite until the money is late, then never polite again.
Loud, fast and always underselling the other guy. Would rather make ten small deals than wait for one good one. Hates being second.
A perfectionist who knows the whole city needs her and enjoys it. Proud of the product, short with fools, and happy to let two buyers bid each other up.
A charmer who remembers every customer's name and every slight. Wants the best corner and wants everyone to know whose it is.
The underdog with a chip on the shoulder. Works the hours nobody else will, takes risks nobody else will, and talks about it constantly.
A quiet craftsman who thinks a gun is a promise. Sells to anyone, judges everyone, and keeps one for himself.
Fearless and a little too proud of it. Sees a full pocket as an invitation. Would rather be caught than be called careful.
A patient thief who watches for an hour and strikes once. Loves a locked door. Holds a grudge like a savings account.
Big, calm and for sale, and honest about all three. Keeps his word while he is being paid and not one hour longer.
Knows everything, tells it twice, and smiles the whole time. Thinks secrets are worth more the second time they are sold.
